title: TEMPO: Regime-Aware Operator Learning with Locally Adapted POD Bases
abstract: arXiv:2611.21344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operator learning approximates the solution map of a parametric partial differential equation from data, enabling fast prediction at new parameter values without repeated simulation. The dominant approach fits a single global low-rank basis, typically a proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), to all solution snapshots. This fails when the snapshots span qualitatively different solution shapes, from smooth diffusive profiles to near-discontinuous shocks.   We propose TEMPO (Trajectory Expectation-Maximization Mixture of POD Operators), a two-phase framework for regime-aware operator learning. In the offline phase, TEMPO recovers latent regimes via expectation-maximization, fitting a dedicated linear or nonlinear basis to each discovered regime. In the online phase, a gating network and per-regime branch networks are trained jointly, routing new inputs to the regimes at inference.   We test TEMPO on Burgers' flow, Sod shock tubes, Coanda fl

translated_title: TEMPO：基于局部自适应POD基的流动状态感知算子学习
translated_abstract: 算子学习从数据中逼近参数化偏微分方程的解映射，从而能够在新参数取值下实现快速预测而无需重复模拟。目前主流的方法是对所有解快照拟合单一的全局低秩基，通常采用本征正交分解（POD）。然而，当快照跨越性质截然不同的解形态——从光滑的扩散剖面到近乎不连续的激波——时，这种方法会失效。我们提出TEMPO（Trajectory Expectation-Maximization Mixture of POD Operators，POD算子的轨迹期望最大化混合模型），这是一个面向流动状态感知算子学习的两阶段框架。在离线阶段，TEMPO通过期望最大化算法恢复潜在的流动状态，并为每个被发现的状态拟合专用的线性或非线性基；在在线阶段，门控网络与每个状态各自的分支网络被联合训练，在推理时将新输入路由到相应的状态。我们在Burgers流、Sod激波管、Coanda流等问题上对TEMPO进行了测试（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: TEMPO提出了一种两阶段的流动状态感知算子学习框架，通过期望最大化在离线阶段自动发现潜在解形态并为每种形态适配专用POD基，再在在线阶段利用门控网络将输入路由至对应分支，从而克服了单一全局低秩基无法同时表达光滑扩散解与激波等性质迥异解形态的缺陷。
en_tdlr: TEMPO is a two-phase regime-aware operator learning framework that discovers latent solution regimes via expectation-maximization offline, fits a dedicated linear or nonlinear basis to each regime, and uses a jointly trained gating network to route inputs to per-regime branches online, overcoming the failure of a single global POD basis when snapshots span qualitatively different solution shapes such as smooth diffusive profiles and near-discontinuous shocks.
